summary: Manage tasks and to-do lists with a GNOME desktop app.
overview: Errands organizes work into separate task lists, with subtasks for breaking a larger item into smaller steps. Its GNOME interface keeps the focus on adding, arranging, and completing tasks. Nextcloud synchronization offers a way to connect those lists to your own service, which is useful if you want desktop task management that can participate in a self-hosted setup.
